name: glasshelf-cf
description: glasshelf on Cloudflare Workers (D1 + R2), same API, MCP and web UI as the Go server

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && wrangler types --strict-vars=false >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.content.jsonc
